scope: Bounded static disassembly of the Split intersection worker in the runtime analysis image.
observations: The worker calls 0x140336010 with a source triangle bounding box and a collector object.
It follows a linked candidate list, applies a pointer-keyed duplicate check and additional intersection tests, then appends an 80-byte record to its worker buffer for accepted candidates.
The candidate list is consumed in list order; the captured worker alone does not establish the spatial query traversal or global order across workers.
qualification: Inferred from decompiler output with a bounded disassembly range; types and control flow require runtime validation. Entry binding and parent call observed separately in live capture. No equivalence claim for untested geometry or worker concurrency.
timeoutDiagnosis: A live jcmd stack from the prior bounded run showed Ghidra recursively enumerating the broad script path; the isolated script directory enabled this run to complete. This was a setup delay, not a confirmed memory exhaustion or disassembler hang.

entryPrefixBinding.scope: Both worker and query entry prefixes match the current running process; this does not verify every instruction or prove query invocation.
